# Rotstruck — Software Development Studio
> Website: https://rotstruck.in
> Contact: team@rotstruck.in
> Rotstruck builds custom digital products: hospital management systems and EMR platforms, education platforms, e-commerce systems, SaaS products, mobile apps, business dashboards, role-based portals, workflow automation and API-connected systems.

- https://rotstruck.in/ — Home: overview of capabilities, featured project MEDBUILDS, process and contact call-to-action

- https://rotstruck.in/industries — Solutions for healthcare, education, retail & e-commerce, SaaS startups, professional services and business operations
- https://rotstruck.in/projects — Case studies including MEDBUILDS (hospital platform), SKOLAR (education), VENDRA (e-commerce), PULSEBOARD (dashboards) and more
- https://rotstruck.in/process — Six-stage delivery process: Discover, Plan, Design, Build, Test, Launch
